title: Calling free on local RenderingDevice causes game to crash with signal 11 when profiler is running
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.1-stable, 4.5-dev-4, and 4.4-stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Ubuntu 25.04 25.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (nvidia; 570.133.07) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

Calling `rd.free()` on a `RenderingDevice` named `rd` that was created through `RenderingServer.create_local_rendering_device()` causes games launched via the editor to close with signal 11, **but only while the profiler is enabled**. Without profiling, everything seems to work without any issue.

Unfortunately, the resulting logs most of the time do not provide any information and look like this:
```
================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official (49a5bc7b616bd04689a2c89e89bda41f50241464)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.4.303 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER
```

I tried opening the project inside a debug build of the editor in hopes that it might give more information, but it seems to only produce an incomplete backtrace similar to the first one above or none whatsoever.

### Steps to reproduce

The following code seems to consistently cause a crash if executed while the profiler is running at game launch, i.e., Autostart was enabled in the profiler toolbar:

```gdscript
extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	print("Create device...")
	var device = RenderingServer.create_local_rendering_device()
	print("Device: ", device)

	print("Free device...")
	device.free() # <--- crash seems to happen here
	print("Done.")
```
